احتكموا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَكَمُوا (iḥtakamū) /iħ.ta.ka.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَكَمَ (iḥtakama)
# اِحْتَكِمُوا (iḥtakimū) /iħ.ta.ki.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَكَمَ (iḥtakama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
